[[Penelope Hoode]] is a [[collector]], a type of [[NPC]] that exchanges [[Trophy|trophies]] for items.

== Locations ==
* [[Ascalon]]
** {{NPC location|Old Ascalon}}

== Dialogue ==
: ''"I'm searching for 3 [[Scorched Seed]]s. I can offer you one of the following items in exchange. Can you help me?"''

== Trivia ==
*The only [[Fast Casting]] skill available in [[Guild Wars Prophecies|Prophecies]] is [[Mantra of Recovery]], which is a stance (thus unaffected by [[HCT]]/[[HSR]]), making the [[Inscribed Chakram]] offered by her rather useless to new characters.
*Presumably named after Penny Hood, a contributor of the [[Guild Wars]] Alpha Test program.
